project.name: Savage Wind Multiplayer
project.distribution: Savage Wind fork builds with native multiplayer compiled in
project.upstream_update_policy: project owner manually integrates new Savage Wind releases

architecture.transport_candidate: libdatachannel v0.24.6 for native M1 source builds
architecture.invite_flow: clipboard invite and reply, public STUN address discovery, direct ICE
architecture.integration: isolated multiplayer core with small build, settings, UI, runtime, and guest-site adapters

milestones.name: Native multiplayer build and internet lobby
milestones.scope: Owner accepted M1 after Windows and Linux clients joined a friend hosting on Linux. Hosting from the owner's network still requires diagnosis.
milestones.open_verification: owner-host direction, selected ICE candidates and full native acceptance matrix

milestones.name: Remote Link presence
milestones.scope: Nearby presence on the main field and in matching shrines, native idle/walk/run/sprint/jump, read-only health, and an independent release version. Windows verified 50 m spawn and 60 m retirement, retained the lobby through Slate travel and two shrine round trips, and held a four-game session for 90 seconds. Full fixture capacity was verified on one renderer.
milestones.manual_follow_up: The owner accepted M2 and deferred remaining manual validation to M7.

milestones.name: Time, weather, and full Link synchronization
milestones.scope: Synchronize host time and weather through one default-on multiplayer option, synchronize equipment and full animations, notify existing players with '[UserName] connected to the game' on admission, and add default-on overhead player names if feasible.
milestones.implemented_slice: Host time and weather in position batches, overlay notices for admission and disconnect, independent revisioned Woodcutter's Axe and Wooden Shield slots, and native landing, axe draw, drawn idle, stow, axe attacks, shield guard and crouch clips.

milestones.name: Combat, enemies, and PvP
milestones.scope: Shared combat, enemies and PvP, plus remote player location markers on the in-game map screen.

milestones.name: Deferred manual validation
milestones.scope: Extended eight-game soak with late join and Leave cleanup, Linux AppImage build and verification against the matching Windows label, and mixed Windows/Linux visibility and Slate travel in both host directions.

last_verified.native_windows: Clang 23.1.5, libdatachannel 0.24.6, matching 1.9.0 gamelib 6bb7f77965924e25; F1 and System > Options share enable, live Host/Join, rejection, two NPCs per renderer, late join, slot reuse, disconnect and disable cleanup; F1 host reboot closed the lobby, and a fresh process restored the enabled preference
last_verified.native_linux_cross: x86-64 and aarch64 multiplayer runtime, presence, settings and menu objects cross-compiled; native link and execution pending
last_verified.direct_signaling: Windows standalone test passed eight peers, malformed and stale input, single-use replies, expiry and cleanup. A two-process Windows runtime test passed with an isolated clipboard. Linux x86-64 transport objects cross-compiled. Native external-network tests pending.
last_verified.m2_plateau_position: Two Windows Vulkan instances on BOTW 1.9.0 and a1c9d2072a418844 rendered base Link proxies. At a 30 FPS target, walk, jump and facing updated in place. Leave, same-slot rejoin, host reboot cleanup, and independent inventory opening passed. The 60 FPS target run verified area withdrawal and return.
last_verified.m2_plateau_animation: Two Windows Vulkan instances with gamelib 34aa482dae306a0d played native idle, walk and jump both ways over direct WebRTC. One renderer sustained all seven fixture-driven proxies for 30 seconds after START. The 60/90/120 targets were exercised below sustained 90/120 FPS.
last_verified.m2_plateau_health: Two Windows Vulkan instances with gamelib e640fd858dc0d033 exchanged native quarter-heart values over direct WebRTC. A controlled scratch client change from 12 to 9 to 12 reached the host while the host's own life stayed at 12.
last_verified.m2_cross_platform_join: Owner confirmed Windows client to Linux host using source ID 970ccbd296037d6d9aec806b7c0c22dca89d1d9e on both ends. The prior rejection came from a stale Windows executable. The matching local launcher is build/m2-health-build/Play-Matching-M2.cmd.
last_verified.m2_visibility_followup: Windows 1.9.0 at 30 FPS verified active proxies at 30 m, withdrawal at 145 m and return in the same lobby using the position-control probe. The build played separate run and sprint clips and recovered both proxies after an in-game save load. Linux x86-64 cross-compile passed. Mixed-platform rendering and Slate travel remain unverified.
last_verified.m2_windows_slate_travel: Two 30 FPS Windows 1.9.0 scratch games retained the original lobby through native Slate travel to Great Plateau Tower and back to the Shrine of Resurrection. At about 92 m both actors repeatedly became inactive. Both were visibly rendered at about 4 m outdoors after repositioning with the control probe. Evidence: build/m2-slate-kcjjyehi/.
last_verified.m2_release_version: Windows link, Configuration capture and startup log verified 0.6.0-alpha.6-0.1.0-mp. The Windows and Linux Make targets reported the same combined label and multiplayer source ID. Windows ZIP naming dry run and Linux launcher x86-64 cross-compile passed. Native Linux and full package creation are pending.
last_verified.m2_shrine_area: Two 30 FPS Windows 1.9.0 scratch clients rendered proxies in the same shrine. Native exit retired both proxies and a separate native entry run activated both after arrival, with the lobby retained during each load. Clients in different shrines stayed admitted without spawning proxies. Windows runtime/app and place tests passed. Linux x86-64 changed runtime objects cross-compiled.
last_verified.m2_open_field_retry: At about 92 m the old build repeatedly retired native actors on the open Plateau. A revised 30 FPS Windows loopback probe recorded one native removal per peer at 92 m and successful recovery at about 4 m in the same lobby. Windows app source ID cfca0ce8eae2beffbe4b682fc9d176d656f66d85.
last_verified.m2_range_acceptance: Windows 1.9.0 two-client direct game check: stable at about 48 and 58 m, withdrew once at 65 m, stayed withdrawn at 57 m, and returned at 48 m without a rejoin.
last_verified.m2_capacity_acceptance: One Windows 1.9.0 renderer held seven fixture-controlled actors in a shrine after START. Six joined late. Fixtures varied snapshot intervals and omitted every third sample. All five clips and changing health appeared in logs. The game measured 60, 90 and 120 FPS at each target. All actors cleaned up on disconnect.
last_verified.m2_full_renderer_soak: Four Windows 1.9.0 games held three remote Links each for 90 seconds at 30.0 measured FPS. Two clients joined after START. Leave cleaned up on all four games. The runner stopped adding peers at 1.89 GiB of available physical RAM and 4.28 GiB of available commit on the 32 GiB host. Evidence: build/m2-accept-eight-6yslv0ug/.
last_verified.m2_linux_multiplayer_tests: Core, eight-peer direct invite and eight-peer WebRTC loopback passed on Ubuntu 22.04 x86-64 under rootless Podman with Clang 21.1.8 and libdatachannel 0.24.6. The Make targets reported the same release label and multiplayer source ID as Windows.
last_verified.m2_shrine_roundtrips: Two Windows 1.9.0 games at 30 FPS retained their lobby through two native shrine elevator round trips. Both proxies retired and reactivated each time.
last_verified.m2_package_acceptance: Windows release ZIP built with LGPL FFmpeg. Manifest and archive integrity passed, including bundled libdatachannel. Packaged imports resolved from the archive staging directory. Linux Make target reported the identical version label. Native AppImage build pending.
last_verified.m2_udp_impairment: Two 30 FPS Windows games exchanged snapshots over direct WebRTC under test-only UDP loss every fifth datagram and 0?45 ms delays. They converged on position, facing and walk/jump/idle in both directions with the same actor and independently reflected a client health change 12 to 9 to 12.
last_verified.m25_windows_environment: Two 30 FPS Windows games with 1.9.0 gamelib 13365c313591b27e followed the host's native clear weather and a controlled rain transition. Clock progression, host and client opt-out, reconnection around midnight, and the host overlay on both admissions passed. A native shrine round trip verified clock resync without leaving the lobby. Synthetic coverage also checks notifications on existing clients.
last_verified.m25_windows_equipment: Two 30 FPS Windows games with 1.9.0 gamelib 13365c313591b27e rendered passive axes and the host's shield over direct WebRTC. Native shield removal and re-equip preserved the axe actor. Shrine exit and re-entry, Leave and same-slot rejoin passed. The client selected axe idle, stow, crouch idle and crouch move. Crouch also passed at 60, 90 and 120 FPS. The guard follow-up on source ID 5b6399a29f68162f952aff5316c44ad03ed9216d selected ShieldGuard and returned to idle. Linux x86-64 cross-compilation passed. Evidence is in build/m25-shield-5ohv11y3/ and build/m25-shield-6ort3715/.

next_recommended_work: Validate a bow slot and broaden the verified traversal and equipment animation map. Investigate native blend and clip progress and the skinned equipment path. Native Linux and mixed-platform gameplay remain open.
